instructions: Complete the table below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER

items.prompt: counted again under the five-millimetre limit, one survey's total was (31) ........ per cent higher
items.evidence: the five-millimetre total came out sixty per cent higher
items.explanation: The lecturer's group counted one survey's samples again under both limits: the total under the five-millimetre limit came out sixty per cent higher than under the old two-millimetre one.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: particles smaller than (31) ........ millimetres count as microplastic
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Senaryo gösterilmeden 3/3 turda doğru bilindi: mikroplastik eşiği (beş milimetre) yazının tek ve sabit değeri, konuşmanın seçtiği bir değer değil.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Senaryo turu (2. reçete). Tur 1'e yerinde bir yan cümle eklendi: aynı anket iki sınıra göre yeniden sayıldığında beş milimetrelik toplam yüzde altmış yüksek çıkıyor. Boşluk artık dünyanın bildiği eşiği değil, konuşmacının kendi sayımından çıkan oranı soruyor; beklenen değerler (iki ve beş milimetre) not sütununa verildi. Tur sayısı ve konuşmacı sırası değişmedi; yeni cevap noktası L5-S4-31 aynı turun içinde. Ayrıca eski not sütunundaki 'bir mikrometrenin altı nanoplastik' ifadesi kaldırıldı — alıştırma kısa cevap sorusunun cevabını düz metin veriyordu.

items.prompt: recent surveys raise the share coming from lost gear to almost (32) ........ of the total
items.evidence: The better surveys of the last decade put it nearer a fifth
items.explanation: The share from lost fishing gear, lines and buoys was long thought to be a tenth; better surveys over the last decade have raised it closer to a fifth.

items.prompt: most of the yearly load passes down in a few (33) ........ weeks
items.evidence: most of the annual load moves in a handful of high-flow weeks
items.explanation: The load carried by rivers is not spread evenly across the year; most of it passes in a few weeks of high flow, which is also the hardest period to sample.

items.prompt: the current figure is about (34) ........ million tonnes a year
items.evidence: The revised estimate, using better waste data, is closer to eleven
items.explanation: For years the figure of eight million tonnes was quoted; the revised estimate, using better waste data, is closer to eleven million tonnes.

items.prompt: shorelines, the water column, the seabed, and pieces too small for our (35) ........ to find
items.evidence: particles that have simply become too small for our instruments
items.explanation: The fourth of the four possible destinations is particles becoming too small for measuring instruments to detect; this is where the importance of nanoplastic comes from.
